vb_textbox.text: Press either the 'S' or 'K' and see how many mushrooms you get. If the key you pressed got less than 2 mushrooms (1 or 0) then alternate to the other key until you get more than 1 mushroom (2 or more). If you got more than 1 then stick with that key until it is less than 2 then switch key. This seemed to work best for me.
